principles: Window uptime alone is not Experience.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect and scheduler wake are zero Experience.
Only independently verified durable capability/recovery/root-cause lessons may create verified system Experience Candidate.
Durable progress and adversarial defect discovery are operational progress, not verified Experience.
Repeated reading of the same durable event must never inflate Experience.
Fresh authority always beats secretary prediction.
A stale secretary signal cannot force a gear change.
Anti-thrash may suppress nonessential upshifts but may never delay a safety or recovery downshift.
v2.1 has no formal mutation authority and cannot modify P_base, Identity, Personality or Governance.

new_controls.verified_progress_density: may justify holding an already-safe inherited gear, never exceeding the inherited v2 decision

all Gearbox v2 tests remain PASS
